0022600193.text: The Golden State Warriors (6-3, riding a six-game winning streak and 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back) host the Orlando Magic (2-6, on a three-game losing streak and 3 games back in the Southeast) in the Warriors' 10th game of the season. The Warriors are without Jimmy Butler III (out, knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (out, illness), and Moses Moody (out, knee surgery), while Draymond Green, Gary Payton II, and Gui Santos are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions; the Magic are without Desmond Bane (out, illness), Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (out, knee), Jonathan Isaac (out, knee), Noah Penda (out, hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (out, ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet this season, and they split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the most recent meeting on December 22, 2025, in San Francisco, where the Warriors won 120-97.
